standard_prerequisites.name: The kernel of a surjection of regular local rings is generated by part of a regular system of parameters
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-regular-quotient-regular}, cited at proof lines 10277-10279

standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the cut ring as a power series ring, so that the flat-fibre criterion applies to it.

standard_prerequisites.name: Formal smoothness of a local map whose special fibre is formally smooth, and base change of formal smoothness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Proposition \ref{proposition-fs-flat-fibre-fs} and Lemma \ref{lemma-base-change-fs}, cited at proof lines 10300-10304
standard_prerequisites.use: Give formal smoothness of R to S once the special fibres agree, and of the base change C = S tensor A over A.

core_obligations: Choose the standard diagram of a power series ring S over a Cohen ring R mapping to A, with residue field k (proof lines 10266-10271).
Use regularity of B and of the special fibre of S to write the kernel of the surjection onto B by elements extending to a regular system of parameters, and lift them to S (proof lines 10272-10282).

Show that cutting S down by those lifts keeps the map from R sending the parameters to part of a regular system of parameters, so the reduction to equal special fibres is legitimate (proof lines 10283-10295).
Apply the flat-fibre criterion to conclude that R to S is formally smooth (proof lines 10296-10300).
Base change to C = S tensor over R with A, which is formally smooth over A in the maximal-adic topology and has the required special fibre (proof lines 10301-10305).
proof_roadmap: Cut S down so that its special fibre is B (proof lines 10272-10295).
Apply the flat-fibre criterion and base change (proof lines 10296-10305).
difficulty_reason: The lemma lifts a formally smooth Noetherian complete local algebra over a residue field to a formally smooth local algebra over a Noetherian complete local ring, with prescribed special fibre. The proof reuses the standard diagram of a power series ring over a Cohen ring mapping to the target: because both the target and the special fibre of the power series ring are regular, the kernel of the surjection onto the target is generated by elements that extend to a regular system of parameters, and cutting the power series ring down by lifts of those elements leaves a power series ring whose special fibre is the target itself. The map from the Cohen ring is then formally smooth by the flat-fibre criterion, and base change along the given ring map produces the required lift.
